purpose: Resolve native cached-voltage timing, nonce mutation and paired finite-volume charge ownership before integration

native_source.scope: Authenticated isolated native class and helper AST execution; caller ordering reviewed from pinned source, without a full native simulation

native_initialization.native_constants: parameters.py defaults F=96485 C/mol and R=8.314 J/(mol K); component exposes both explicitly, preserving native defaults and supporting deliberate caller overrides
native_initialization.concentrations: Copy all cytosolic ion concentrations; cytosolic concentration/full cell volume remain unchanged
native_initialization.diffusivity_copies: Current, base and channel arrays start at the same minimum; only current Dm_mit is read by update
native_initialization.voltage_and_charge_cache: Zero without calling get_v, even if copied ions/extra charge would imply a nonzero charge
native_initialization.extra_charge_density: Absent in raw Mito constructor; caller must supply it before refresh/update

native_update.ordering: Moving ion list order, explicit Euler concentration updates, one charge/voltage refresh after all ions
native_update.voltage: Mitochondrial minus cytosolic potential, from the incoming cached Vmit
native_update.nonce: Actual electroflux mutates Vmit by +1e-25 per moving ion, in order; valence nonce acts on a temporary array
native_update.units: c in mM=mol/m3; D in m2/s; thickness in m; density in mol/(m2 s); volumes in m3; area in m2; charge in C; capacitance in F; dt in s

source_limits: Ca uniporter, channels and ETC/ATP-related descriptions are inactive comments in this class; no ATP synthesis is implemented
Optimizer-only Vmit=-150mV override is not the constructor's initial voltage
Native update does not guard negative concentrations; this component rejects invalid predicted trials without clamping or retry
Vmit=-1e-25 before a first moving ion reaches alpha=0 and native 0/0; no regularized replacement is claimed
Raw constructor lacks extra_rho; get_v/update can raise AttributeError until the caller supplies it
remove_mits deletes geometry/concentration/D/valence arrays but leaves extra_rho unchanged; subsequent shapes can fail or silently broadcast
Caller redefine_dynamic_dics constructs a fresh Mito, resetting rather than preserving organelle state
Integer synthetic initial concentration arrays truncate minimum D to zero; float32 arrays lose diffusivity/concentration-update precision. Supported component precision is float64

supported_domain.topology: One paired cytosol/mitochondrion per active cell, fixed integer species valences in [-8,8], unique ordered moving species; explicit zero padding
supported_domain.state: Finite nonnegative float64 concentrations and finite float64 cached Q/V; incoming cached values are not forced to match a charge refresh
supported_domain.geometry: Finite positive active volumes/area/capacitance/thickness; fixed mitochondrial geometry, independently supplied current cytosolic volume
supported_domain.parameters: Finite nonnegative current/base/channel D, positive finite isothermal temperature, explicit finite extra charge density
supported_domain.dt: Finite nonnegative scalar or per-world singleton, including a zero-time charge refresh
supported_domain.trial: Finite nonnegative predicted concentrations, finite fluxes/charge/voltage; pure kernels do not mutate inputs or repair rejected trials

reference: Independent 80-digit scalar Decimal flux, explicit per-ion Euler updates and molar charge sums; no Cells/NumPy/JAX imports

reduced_physical_check.purpose: Resolve half-volume/half-area and diffusivity-versus-permeability units with an analytic finite two-volume relaxation
reduced_physical_check.scope: Single neutral moving species, fixed native geometry, default D, zero extra charge and cached voltage; not all-ion/full-cell mitochondrial settling
reduced_physical_check.horizon: Twelve actual linear diffusion time constants, with three explicit-Euler refinements and analytic profiles

integration_energy_limit: Explicit ion amounts/charge and cached-voltage refresh only. No ATP/water/respiration or physical heat ledger is inferred. Source copy initialization and cache/external-charge work require explicit caller accounting.
